newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-STEFFI GRAF SET FOR COMEBACK IN BERLIN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-STEFFI GRAF SET FOR COMEBACK IN BERLIN.

text.p: Steffi Graf will return to competitive tennis at next month's German Open after an injury layoff of more than three months, the Berlin tournament's organisers said on Monday.
Eberhard Wensky, the director of the tournament which begins on May 12, said Graf had confirmed she would take part.
The German has been out of action with a knee injury since the beginning of February. She lost her status as world number one to Martina Hingis of Switzerland last month.
